description: Source file implementing utility functions for DCA component, including load average retrieval, file size calculation, log rotation handling, execution count management, and configuration updates.

methods.name: getLoadAvg
methods.description: Reads system load average from /proc/loadavg and adds it to search results.

methods.name: fsize
methods.description: Calculates the size of an open file stream.

methods.name: updateExecCounter
methods.description: Updates the current execution count from a file.

methods.name: saveExecCounter
methods.description: Saves the current execution count to a file.

methods.name: isSkipParam
methods.description: Determines whether to skip telemetry based on polling interval and execution count.

methods.name: getsRotatedLog
methods.description: Retrieves a line from a rotated log file, handling log rotation and seeking.

methods.name: updateIncludeConfVal
methods.description: Updates global paths from include.properties file.

methods.name: updateConfVal
methods.description: Updates configuration values from device.properties and include properties.

methods.name: readLogSeek
methods.description: Reads the seek position for a log file from persistent storage.

methods.name: writeLogSeek
methods.description: Writes the seek position for a log file to persistent storage.
